profile_text.body:
Murf is an AI voice and conversational agent platform that describes itself as trusted by 10 million or more developers, businesses, and creators. The company offers a suite of voice products including a text-to-speech API, an AI voice generator, AI dubbing for video localization, and deployable conversational agents designed for inbound and outbound calls and chat. Its platform supports 35 or more languages, including English, German, French, Spanish, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese, Japanese, and others, and is positioned for use cases ranging from content creation and narration to customer support and sales automation.

Murf's core AI models are Falcon 2, described as its lowest-latency text-to-speech model built for real-time conversations using a compute-efficient proprietary neural architecture, and Gen2, a customization-focused speech model that supports controls for tone, pacing, and emphasis and is aimed at large-scale content production. The company states that users may apply commercial rights to voiceovers generated on the platform, provided the underlying text is original and does not infringe existing copyrights.

The site's held facts confirm that Murf operates under the product name Murf.ai, categorized as a voice synthesis offering in the Voice and Audio space. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
